title: Route version checkpoint
description: A checkpoint at a position of a route version. Identified by (route_version_id, position); immutable like its version. Every property is present; absent values are null.

position.description: Order within the version, starting at 1; a version has at most 500 positions.

anyOf.description: Measured walk from the previous position in seconds (at most 86400, a day); null for position 1 and after reordering.
